verifier_note: Checked against primary sources retrieved 2026-09-25: the SDXL paper (arXiv:2307.01952), the Qwen-Image tech report (arXiv:2508.02324) and its diffusers pipeline source (huggingface/diffusers qwenimage/pipeline_qwenimage.py and pipeline_qwenimage_edit.py, current main), the CFG paper (Ho & Salimans, arXiv:2207.12598) and Lin et al. 2023's guidance-rescale paper (arXiv:2305.08891, WACV2024), the negative-prompt neutralization paper (Ban et al., arXiv:2406.02965, ECCV2024), the CLIP bag-of-words paper (Koishigarina/Uselis/Oh, arXiv:2502.03566) and the CLIP geometric-ceiling paper (arXiv:2503.08723, ICCV2025), the T5-distillation paper (Wang et al., arXiv:2503.19897, CVPR2025), FLUX/Chroma/Z-Image-Turbo model cards and ComfyUI node docs, and the seed-transfer paper (Xu et al., arXiv:2405.14828, WACV2025). 31 of 34 entries confirmed as stated, including several verbatim matches (Qwen system-prompt templates byte-for-byte, Rescale-CFG's w=7.5/phi=0.7, and the Reverse-Activation paper's step-5/step-10/99.5%-correlation figures). 3 entries needed correction: one misattributes a real CLIP bag-of-words finding to 'Lin et al.' when the actual authors are Koishigarina/Uselis/Oh (likely bleed-through from the correctly-cited but unrelated Lin et al. 2023 CFG paper elsewhere in this same lane); one states Qwen-Image has 'no hard token cap (32k+)' when its diffusers pipeline actually defaults to the same 512-token budget as Z-Image, conflating the underlying LLM's raw context window with the actual image-conditioning budget (this lane's own entry 10 states the correct 512 figure for both models); one gives FLUX-dev's distilled guidance value as '~1-1.5' when the documented default is 3.5, conflating it with the unrelated sampler-level real-CFG scalar of 1.0. No harmful advice (nothing destructive or state-corrupting) was found; the CFG-value error would only produce under-adherent FLUX output if followed literally. Systemic weakness: the lane's citation discipline is excellent on mechanism (every mechanism claim I tried to falsify held up against a primary source, several verbatim) but fails specifically where two genuinely different numbers or author names are topically adjacent within the same lane — the errors are bleed-through/conflation between real facts, not invention.

verdicts.verify_note: Confirmed: Koishigarina/Uselis/Oh (arXiv:2502.03566) show CLIP matches 'orange square+blue triangle' to swapped-attribute captions; binding exists unimodally, lost cross-modally.
Confirmed: CLIP has 77 absolute positional slots; HF diffusers truncates prompts over 77 tokens (75+BOS+EOS) with only a console warning, per diffusers issue #2136.
Confirmed by consistent community sourcing: base SDXL favors natural-language-ish captions; booru-tag anime finetunes (Pony/Illustrious/Animagine/NovelAI) need comma-tag prompts.
Core bag-of-words finding is real (matches claim exactly) but misattributed to 'Lin et al.' — the actual authors are Koishigarina, Uselis & Oh (arXiv:2502.03566, ICLR2026).

corrections.claim: The orange-square/blue-triangle binding finding is Koishigarina, Uselis & Oh (arXiv:2502.03566, ICLR2026) — not 'Lin et al.'; no Lin paper proves this result. The core claim (CLIP fails cross-modal attribute binding) is itself accurate.

verdicts.verify_note: Confirmed as synthesis: rests on independently-verified mechanisms in this lane (77-token truncation, bag-of-words degradation, T5 non-response to non-visual tokens per Wang 2025).
Confirmed verbatim: arXiv:2503.08723 (ICCV2025) proves a CLIP-style embedding represents at most two of {description, attribute binding, spatial relations, negation} at once.
Confirmed: SD/SDXL/FLUX VAEs use 8x spatial downsampling (kl-f8 lineage, Rombach et al. 2112.10752); a 70px face at 1024px frame lands in roughly an 8-9px latent patch.
Corrected: Qwen2.5-VL-7B/last-hidden-state encoder claim is right, but Qwen-Image's diffusers pipeline caps prompts at max_sequence_length=512 by default, not '32k+'.

corrections.claim: Qwen-Image's diffusers pipeline defaults max_sequence_length=512 (HF docs) — same order as Z-Image's budget, not '32k+'. That figure is Qwen2.5-VL's raw LLM context window, not the actual image-conditioning token budget used.

verdicts.verify_note: Confirmed: Wang et al. CVPR2025 (arXiv:2503.19897) show T5-conditioned diffusion 'does not respond to non-visual prompts'; non-depictable tokens dilute depictable ones.
Confirmed: Qwen-Image and Z-Image diffusers pipelines both default max_sequence_length=512 (HF docs), matching this entry exactly.
Confirmed verbatim: Qwen-Image-Edit's diffusers template matches exactly, including <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|> and prompt_template_encode_start_idx=64.
Confirmed verbatim: Qwen-Image's diffusers system-prompt text and drop_idx=34 match the pipeline source word for word.
Confirmed: CFG's guidance term inflates latent magnitude/std as w grows (Lin et al. 2023 and corroborating sources), producing the documented over-exposure/'fried' look.
Confirmed verbatim: Lin et al. 2023 (arXiv:2305.08891) report 'w=7.5, phi=0.7 works great' and phi in [0.5,0.75] as the appealing range for guidance rescale.
Confirmed: Ho & Salimans 2022 CFG formula; the documented negative-prompt variant replaces the unconditional branch with a real negative encode, exactly as described.
Confirmed: arXiv:2406.02965 documents the cancellation mechanism; community sources confirm SDXL/SD3.5/FLUX need far less negative than SD1.5, and removing negatives can help SD3.5.
Confirmed: arXiv:2406.02965's 'Deletion Through Neutralization' mechanism directly supports that a negative overlapping the positive's own content cancels it out.
Confirmed pattern: CLIP 77-token vs T5/Qwen 512-token limits verified elsewhere in this lane; arXiv:2504.01137 (cross-token info flow) is topically supportive context.
Confirmed: attention-dilution research supports the mechanism; community hand-anatomy tests found 'basically zero effect' from long bad-hands negative blocks.
Confirmed: SDXL paper gives CLIP-L(768)+bigG(1280)=2048 dims; SD1.5's 768-dim TI embeddings have no bigG half, confirmed incompatible by practitioner sources.
Confirmed verbatim: arXiv:2406.02965 names 'Reverse Activation' and 'Inducing Effect,' peak noun removal at step 5, adjective plateau ~step 10, 99.5% noise correlation in first 25 steps.
Confirmed: grounded in standard diffusion mechanics (seed fixes structural scaffold, prompt defines content), consistent with Discovering Secret Seeds (arXiv:2405.14828).
Confirmed as a workflow corollary of verified seed mechanics (fixed seed = fixed structure across prompt edits); no single doc prescribes the loop, but the underlying fact holds.
Confirmed: ancestral/SDE samplers re-inject random noise every step (never converge, not reproducible); deterministic samplers (DDIM/Euler/Heun/DPM++2M) reproduce exactly.
Confirmed: fixed seed only fixes starting noise, not identity across different prompts; LoRA/reference-conditioning are the standard reliable consistency levers.
Confirmed: Xu, Zhang & Shi (arXiv:2405.14828, WACV2025) built their seed dataset across exactly SD 2.0 (multi-step) and SDXL Turbo (distilled), matching the cited comparison.
Corrected: family-specific-CFG framing is right, but FLUX-dev's distilled guidance defaults to 3.5, not '~1-1.5' — that number conflates it with the sampler's real-CFG value of 1.0.

corrections.claim: FLUX-dev's distilled guidance value defaults to 3.5 (ComfyUI FluxGuidance default, typical range ~2-5), not '~1-1.5.' The 1.0 figure is the separate sampler-level real-CFG scalar, not the guidance embedding value.

verdicts.verify_note: Confirmed: standard DDPM/latent-diffusion fact (Rombach et al. 2112.10752) — the seed fixes z_T only; the denoiser interprets it through the prompt conditioning.
Confirmed: weakly-conditioned generation regresses toward the dataset mean (the behavior CFG's unconditional branch represents), consistent with Ho & Salimans 2022 framing.
Confirmed: CLIP's absolute positional embeddings create order sensitivity (arXiv:2511.11216 on positional bias); T5's bidirectional attention and Qwen's causal LM handling differ as described.
Confirmed: FLUX-dev/schnell are guidance-distilled with no real negative branch; Z-Image-Turbo uses guidance=0/no CFG; Chroma is de-distilled from schnell with true CFG re-enabled.
Confirmed directionally: CLIP's well-trained token count is under ~20 (Long-CLIP paper); T5/Qwen-Image/Z-Image operate on a larger but still bounded ~512-token budget.
Confirmed verbatim: Wang et al. CVPR2025 (arXiv:2503.19897) — T5-conditioned diffusion doesn't respond to non-visual prompts; distilled T5-Base is 50x smaller at comparable quality.
Confirmed: the T5/diffusers path truncates silently past max_sequence_length with no error; ComfyUI's CLIP path instead auto-chunks into 75-token blocks, unlike native T5 handling.
